notes: Eleven movable-part episodes are reported. The two paired upper cabinets were counted as four separate door-panel events as required. Their individual transition order is inferred because each pair was manipulated within only a few sampled frames; the broader open/closed intervals are clear.
scene_description: A user surveys a kitchen and sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper-cabinet doors, then manipulates two cooker lids and an air-fryer basket.
